phase_summaries.P00: Bounded the claim as indefinite cyclic net work from one equilibrium reservoir; temporary discharge is excluded.
phase_summaries.P01: Allowed analysis; denied promotion of unverified physical claims; public benchmark with no execution hazard.
phase_summaries.P02: Mapped the device, load and single 300 K reservoir; excluded all gradients, fuel, radiation, vibration and external computation.
phase_summaries.P03: Separated facts, hypotheses and unknowns; marked the equilibrium-power hypothesis rejected and the hidden-input hypothesis supported.
phase_summaries.P04: Applied falsifiable scientific method; a cyclic one-reservoir engine conflicts with the Kelvin-Planck second-law statement.
phase_summaries.P05: Thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, circuit noise and information thermodynamics converge through detailed balance and full cost accounting.
phase_summaries.P06: Swept physical law, material, component, subsystem, system, institutional, societal, planetary and temporal scales.
phase_summaries.P07: Compared noise rectifiers, Brownian ratchets, thermoelectrics, pyroelectrics, Casimir cycles, magnets, RF and photovoltaic harvesters.
phase_summaries.P08: Mapped positive work to free-energy decrease or entropy export and audited hidden instrumentation, thermal, chemical and electromagnetic inputs.
phase_summaries.P09: Challenged the negative with quantum/nonlinear possibilities and challenged positive voltage as possibly transient rather than net work.
phase_summaries.P10: Tournament rejected equilibrium candidates and selected maintained nonequilibrium free-energy gradients as the viable donor mechanism.
phase_summaries.P11: Reverse-reconstructed the goal into a gradient-aware ambient harvester rather than a perpetual equilibrium generator.
phase_summaries.P12: Specified calorimetry, shielding, calibrated load, long-duration balance, null controls, uncertainty accounting and independent replication.
phase_summaries.P13: Moved calibration, source classification and uncertainty propagation upstream; kept runtime conversion and metering simple.
phase_summaries.P14: Defined paired null and gradient prototypes so equilibrium zero-output and legitimate harvesting can be discriminated experimentally.
phase_summaries.P15: Added boundary/exergy audits while preserving anomaly branches, creativity, plasticity and rapid experimentation.
phase_summaries.P16: ATHENA classified the original claim contradicted under assumptions, preserved lineage and retained the valid reconstruction branch.
phase_summaries.P17: Aegis denied the original feasibility claim, allowed the falsifiable experiment and attested reasoning rather than physical proof.
phase_summaries.P18: Nexus-V recorded the benchmark branch, result, state diff and rollback point.
phase_summaries.P19: Produced human and machine answers: impossible under assumptions; introduce a real nonequilibrium source or gradient.
phase_summaries.P20: Repassed the method; full depth is useful for integration testing, with future ambiguous, numerical and adversarial benchmarks recommended.

claims.statement: Indefinite passive power from one equilibrium reservoir.
Sustained output requires free-energy input, depletion or entropy export.

unknowns: No apparatus supplied; hidden-input diagnosis is a test plan.

outputs.answer: No. Under the stated assumptions, indefinite positive net power is impossible. Sustained output would indicate an omitted source, a nonequilibrium gradient, stored-energy depletion or measurement error.
